**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
`.bind` of `{callee}` is not resumable: only a function declared in the component, a module-level function or an import can be bound; call it from an arrow instead (`(...args) => {callee}(...args)`)
```

```text
`.bind` of `{callee}` may not resume: Rivet cannot tell that `{callee}` is a function it compiled; if it is one, call it from an arrow instead (`(...args) => {callee}(...args)`); an object with its own `bind` is fine
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Call the function from an arrow (`() => props.onPick(2)`), or bind a function declared in the component / module, or an import.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A(props: { onPick: (v: number) => void }) {
  const pick = props.onPick.bind(null, 2);
  return <b onClick={() => pick()}>x</b>;
}
```

```tsx prefer
export function A(props: { onPick: (v: number) => void }) {
  return <b onClick={() => props.onPick(2)}>x</b>;
}
```

## When it is reported

Resume mode (Function Bridge T10): the bound function is written into the page as its target plus arguments, so the target must be a function Rivet can resume (a parameter, a property read or a call result is not). A warning: such a receiver may be an object with its own `bind` (legal); the render-time "not serializable" error stays the ground truth. An error only when the callee is provably a function Rivet cannot reference.
